text:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to lock the deliverables for the econ+alerts pilot (recommendations for batching/caching/quant + eval-triggered alerts). Customer asks: low-friction UI + deterministic guardrails. What are the absolute must-haves for an MVP? @Sam @Liu @Maya :eyes:
Sam: Runtime needs two things: (1) an advisor API that returns a recommended profile for (model, seq_len, qtype) and (2) console knobs that can apply a profile quickly. Rough estimate: runtime + console UI = ~2 dev sprints if unblocked.
Liu: Eval side: we need signal definitions and a lightweight regression hook. Minimal signals: perplexity delta, token-level quality check failures, and generation-time latency. Also need a way to attach an eval set per-customer for drift detection.
Maya: From customer side: pilot asks for an explanation when recommendations change (simple diff) and a daily digest email of alerts. Pilot customer is AcmeHealth — must be VPC / private-deploy friendly and PHI-safe.
Ethan: Ops constraints: rollout must support canary -> 10% -> 50% with automatic fallback to previous model variant. Track p95 latency, token-cost-per-request, and error-rate. Also need an outage playbook and runbook entries.
Priya: Proposed MVP acceptance criteria (short):
- Advisor API returns a profile for 95% of observed request shapes within 200ms.
- Console can apply chosen profile to a customer in <5 clicks.
- Eval hooks trigger an alert when metric crosses threshold for 3 consecutive days.
- Pilot customer can opt into VPC mode and receive daily digest.
Sam: Example of the minimal profile payload we'll expose to the console:```json
{
  "model": "gpt-xxl",
  "max_batch_size": 32,
  "max_latency_ms": 50,
  "quant_profile": "int8_symmetric",
  "cache_policy": "prefix_kv_cache:enabled"
}```
Liu: For alerts, minimal alert config: `metric`, `threshold`, `window_days`, `notify_emails`. We'll wire that to eval jobs.
Maya: I'll draft the customer acceptance checklist and ask AcmeHealth if they can provide a daily sample eval set by next Wed.
Ethan: Infra note: quotas look fine but we need approval for reserving 2x A100 for the pilot window. I'll file a ticket today (TKT-3249).
Priya: Great — owners: Sam=runtime+console, Liu=eval+alerts, Maya=customer onboarding, Ethan=infra/rollout. I'll convert this thread into an RFC and a short deliverables checklist. Meeting to review: Friday 11:00am PT. :thumbsup:
Sam: Ack, I'll sketch API surface before Thu EOD.
Liu: I'll prototype the regression detector and a sample alert email template.
Maya: I'll confirm AcmeHealth availability and privacy paperwork.
Ethan: Filing infra ticket now, will ping when approved.
Priya: Thanks all — moving this to an RFC now and adding owners/tasks.
